title: Torque Converter
text: 由泵轮、涡轮和导轮组成的三元件液力变矩器；输出 3 路；按 {Interpolation method} 指定插值方法；{Lock-up clutch configuration} 指定锁止离合器配置、{Impeller shaft inertia, Ji} 指定惯性 .1、{Impeller shaft viscous damping, bi} 指定粘性阻尼系数 .001、{Turbine shaft inertia, Jt} 指定惯性 .1、{Turbine shaft viscous damping, bt} 指定粘性阻尼系数 .001、{Initial impeller shaft velocity, omegai_o} 指定角速度、{Initial turbine shaft velocity, omegat_o} 指定角速度、{Speed ratio vector, phi} 指定比值、{Capacity factor parameterization} 指定因子比类型 Input speed / sqrt、{Capacity vector, psi} 指定向量、{Torque ratio vector, zeta} 指定向量、{Fluid torque response time constant (set to 0 to disable), tauTC} 指定时间常数 .02、{Clutch force equivalent net radius, Reff} 指定有效半径 .3、{Static friction coefficient, mus} 指定系数、{Kinetic friction coefficient, muk} 指定系数、{Start simulation with clutch initially locked} 以初始锁定离合器、{Lock-up speed ratio threshold, philu} 指定阈值 .85、{Minimum lock-up engagement speed, omegal} 指定角速度 900*pi/30、{Lock-up disengagement speed, omegau} 指定角速度 800*pi/30、{Lock-up clutch force gain, K_c} 指定 Gain、{Lock-up clutch time constant, tauC} 指定时间常数 .0500，按实例取值。

params.name: Lock-up clutch configuration
params.values: 选择锁止离合器配置 Lock-up (default) | No lock-up | External lock-up input

params.name: Capacity factor parameterization
params.values: 选择因子比类型 Input speed / sqrt(input torque) (default) | Absorbed torque / input speed^2

params.name: Fluid torque response time constant (set to 0 to disable), tauTC
Interpolation method
params.values: 选择插值方法 Linear (default) | Flat | Nearest

params.name: Clutch force equivalent net radius, Reff
Start simulation with clutch initially locked
params.values: 选择以初始锁定离合器 off (default) | on
